From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-09-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Field playbook + 1-page seller script for AWS listing (first draft attached)

Team —

I'm putting together a very short field playbook and single-slide seller script to hand to the AWS account teams and our channel partners as soon as the listing goes live. Goal is one PDF (playbook) and one CSV of copilot snippets for outbound/demo follow-ups.

Key asks:
- Kimberly: please review the buyer personas and proof points — make sure the language aligns with the listing copy and the technical bullets we approved last week.
- Marissa: tighten the win themes and add two customer examples we can surface in calls.
- Aditya: confirm pricing anchors and whether we should lead with Usage-cost-per-1k-tokens or with monthly committed capacity math for one-pagers.

Timeline: I need an updated draft by end of day tomorrow so we can hand to AWS sellers on Monday. I attached v1 of the playbook and a CSV of candidate copilot snippets.

Attachments: AWS_Field_Playbook_v1.pdf (draft), Copilot_SNIPPETS_v3.csv (examples)

Thanks — short and sharp please.

—Stephanie

Subject: Re: Field playbook + 1-page seller script for AWS listing (first draft attached)

Stephanie —

Thanks for the draft. Quick pass attached with inline comments (I flagged a couple of technical claims that need evidence or softer wording). High-level notes:

- Personas: add an "SRE/Platform" persona in addition to "AI Product" and "ML Infra". Many AWS sellers will sell to platform teams first.
- Proof points: swap one of the latency claims for a concrete percentile (p99) stat rather than average latency.
- Messaging: replace phrase "deploy anywhere" with "deploy on-hosted, dedicated, or private deployments" to reflect our product modes — it's more explicit for procurement folks.

I also suggested two short call openers for the CSV (one for platform owners, one for CTO-level execs). I left the pricing anchor comment to Aditya.

I'll be available for a quick sync at 2pm if you want to walk through the changes.

-Kim

Adding two quick customer vignettes (one ISV, one mid-market SaaS) in the attached draft and tightening the win themes — emphasized cost predictability and multi‑deployment parity (that hits both procurement and platform buyers).

Two small suggestions:
- Replace the long demo checklist with a 4-step "must show" list (speed demo, cost math, fallback policy, security controls). AWS sellers like something they can run through in 5 mins.
- Include a single objection-handling line for enterprise procurement on data residency (we have the private deployment option + KMS/HSM integration).

I also updated a handful of the copilot snippets to be shorter, more CTA-driven.

Marissa

Subject: Re: Field playbook + 1-page seller script for AWS listing (first draft attached)

Quick pricing note — for the one-pager we should lead with the committed-capacity math for enterprise customers (monthly committed nodes / predictable cost), and have a small blurb showing equivalent per-1k-token usage cost for comparison. That maps to how AWS sellers frame commercial conversations (they want committed vs burst logic).

Also: suggest we include a short cell in the playbook that lists the three fallback model-variants (e.g., quantized medium variant, low-cost burst variant) for when capacity/latency trades are discussed on calls. Keeps sellers from promising features we can't consistently deliver at high concurrency.

I added two sample calculation lines to the attached CSV.

-Aditya

Thanks Stephanie — this looks useful. Couple of asks from the AWS seller side:

1) Can you add a single-line slide that summarizes the "deal sweet spot" (company size, typical spend, ROI line) — our sellers want a quick gating filter.
2) Any objection-handling material for "managed vs self-hosted" pricing differentiation would be helpful.

We plan to distribute to the West Coast seller pod on Monday. If you can make the updates by EOD today we'll slot it into our enablement pack.

Subject: Finalized field playbook and seller scripts — ready for AWS pod

Sam / team —

Attached is the updated playbook (final v1) and the short CSV with copilot snippets we agreed on. Changes made:
- Added a single-line "deal sweet spot" (mid-market SaaS and ISV with >$5k/mo expected usage).
- Pricing section leads with committed-capacity math; inline comparison shows per-1k-token equivalent.
- 4-step demo "must show" checklist and one-liner objection responses for data residency and managed vs self-hosted pricing.
- Added three model-variant fallback bullets and p99 latency stat.

Sam: please distribute to the West Coast pod. We'll track any feedback in SELL-882 (link in the doc). If the pod asks for tweaks, we'll roll a v1.1 next week.

Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround.

—Stephanie

Attachments: AWS_Field_Playbook_v1.pdf (final v1), Copilot_SNIPPETS_v3.csv (finalized)
